verdict.rationale: Foreloop has its own nested work model: projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks. Feedback submissions route to a project or to an org-level Feedback list, and an intention can be started from a report with tasks proposed by an agent. This gives some hierarchical organization of requests, but it is not the feature/component/initiative structure the story describes, and the docs never explain how the levels nest or are grouped. Missing for 10: explicit feature/component/initiative levels, documentation of how requests are grouped and rolled up across the hierarchy, a UI for reorganizing items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
